messages:
ana: Heads-up — opened PR to fold the legacy /models -> new /generate migration guidance into a single migration guide and a short deprecation notice for the website. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 Please focus reviews on: snippet correctness, redirect mappings, and SDK examples. Target merge: Tue EOD.

ben: Quick q — do we keep the old `.invoke()` compat snippet in the guide or remove it and only show the new pattern? Some Dedicated customers still call the shim.

sam: I recommend keeping a tiny compat section (1 short snippet) that explicitly says "temporary shim behavior" and links to the fallback policy. But main examples should show the new `client.generate()` flow.

lee: I can own the snippets and smoke tests. I'll add a small compat snippet that shows both calls side-by-side and a callout about streaming semantics changing. Assigning to @lee on the PR.

olivia: I've added a redirect entry in redirects.csv for `/v1/models` -> `/guides/migration/generate` and left a comment in the PR with the exact line. Also added a note for the docs release notes.

docs-bot: Deploy preview ready: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.dev/ (expires in 24h).

ana: @ben @lee can you confirm JS + Py snippet parity? Ben: JS; Lee: Py? We need identical param names and the example output shape.

ben: I'll update JS snippets. Plan: change `.invoke({model: 'x', input})` -> `client.generate({model: 'x', input})` and add a short `// fallback` example showing the shim call. Will also note that streaming token framing differs (`delta` vs `text`).

lee: I'll update Python and the CLI examples. For CLI we should keep `redwood model invoke` as deprecated and show `redwood generate` as the primary. Adding the deprecation banner in the CLI example.

sam: Test checklist I put on the PR: 1) render smoke tests (docs smoke runner) 2) run snippets through the snippet linter 3) run example-app with new SDKs 4) verify redirects work in preview 5) add changelog entry. Tick off items as you go.

lee: Running smoke tests now. Quick failure: streaming example in guide used the older framing; the preview shows garbled tokens in the browser console. Replacing with streaming snippet using the `onDelta` handler fixes it. Patch incoming.

ben: Pushed JS snippet fix — changed to:
```js
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'translate to fr: Hello' });
for await (const chunk of res.stream()) { console.log(chunk.delta?.text ?? chunk.text); }
```
Added comment about `delta` field for streaming.

olivia: I left one nit about wording on the deprecation banner — prefer "soft-sunset" language instead of "immediate removal". Also flagged that the migration timeline should link to the Dedicated notice.

ana: Good call @olivia — updated banner copy in the PR. Timeline we propose: soft-sunset email + console banner next week, shim maintained for 6 weeks, full removal after the take-down window unless critical rollback requested. Add Enterprise exceptions in the private-deploy section.

sam: Reminder: SDK param rename note — users who pinned older SDKs will see `method` -> `api_call` rename in 2.0. Need compatibility note in the migration guide and a tiny compat shim example in each SDK.

ben: I'll add the compatibility example to the JS SDK README (short snippet and a link to the guide). Then open a tiny PR in the SDK repo and link it here.

lee: Smoke tests good after streaming patch. Found one other small issue: code block in the HTML rendering escapes backticks incorrectly — changed to fenced triple backticks in MD.

docs-bot: CI passed (docs-lint, snippet-lint). 6 changed files.

ana: Awesome. Action items: @ben update JS SDK README PR link in this thread, @lee confirm Python README update, @olivia sync on redirect timing, @sam merge checklist done. I'll aim to merge Tue EOD unless any blocker pops up.

ben: PR for JS README -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/231 landed (contains compat snippet).

lee: Python README PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/118 ready for review.

olivia: Redirects staged. Will coordinate with infra to ensure preview rollout includes the redirect.

sam: I'm marking the checklist items done on the PR and adding the changelog entry.

ana: Thanks all — ping here if any last-minute regressions. :thumbsup:
